title: The app-not-installed remedy names bin/devbin, which a Homebrew user does not have
body:
`macapp.rs:178` (as at the audit) tells the user to run `bin/devbin`, a dev-tree tool. A Homebrew user's route is `Intent.app.zip` from the release. (dc, from reading the code)

Found by hv's estate-wide doc audit of 2026-09-11 (the audit's orders are in `intent/history/20260911-doc-audit.md`), where it is described as built. Carried in `intent/wip.md` as an unruled defect until 2026-09-13, when that file was leaned and every open defect became an issue. Not worked until hv rules it; a ruled one gets a lane.


CLOSED 2026-09-14 (dc): the NotInstalled remedy is chosen by the install root this binary resolved. A source tree (one carrying `bin/devbin`) is sent to `bin/devbin macos app-build` / `app-install`; any other install is sent to `Intent.app.zip` from its own release, v{CARGO_PKG_VERSION}, with the release URL. The choice is a pure function of the root, `not_installed_remedy`, and `install::home()` remains the one ambient read, at the call. Judged by a unit test driving both branches (scratchpad batch/judge-0327.txt, 17:28:39Z): a root with `bin/devbin` gets the devbin text, while a root without it, and no root at all, get the release text with no devbin mention. Not driven end to end: `/Applications/Intent.app` is installed on this machine, so the error cannot fire here.
